Real solver output: all endpoints connected and full-span via copper validated.
Lengths include TOP approaches and INNER1 carriers; this fixture requests connectivity and clearance, without bus length constraints.
Core compiles twelve standard 0402 resistors, all 24 pads, traces and keepouts → native matcher. No mocked routes or hand-authored SRJ geometry.
Budget: 1 coarse pass + 1 pass per local stage, 100,000 expansions/search. Main can recover with a larger pass budget.
